en: This supposedly magic weapon features an adorable penguin on the end that is said to come alive each night.
These popular brawling weapons can increase damage dealt when wearing them on both fists.
Steel knuckles that can guard against blades. Strong and easy to use.
The thorns on the fists of these knuckles slice into their unlucky foes.
Unique gauntlets that shield the entire fist. Perhaps this is what kompeito candy is modeled after.
A legendary gauntlet imbued with a dragon's grudge that protects the wearer from blades and bullets.
This modified version of the Dragon Grudge Gloves bashes enemies apart with their overwhelming attack power and durability.
Gloves that are capable of draining health from opponents, as if the wearer were a hungry wolf.
Your average can of pepper spray, designed for self-defense.
Spray some on the floor to make enemies slip.
Works like a handy little flamethrower.
A stun gun and a modified lighter fused into one hell of a weapon.
This lighter never runs out of fluid.
This ordinary saltshaker is full of salt.
This ordinary peppershaker full of ordinary pepper would be perfect to blind someone temporarily.
If this stuff got in your eyes, it would probably leave you sprawled on the ground in agony.
This instant-bonding glue just might be able to stop an opponent dead in his tracks.
This firework includes a warning about not firing it at people. Once you take it out, you can't put it away again.
This is made of pipe iron, making it fairly lightweight.
This steel tonfa is really tough.
A cutting-edge tonfa for weapon enthusiasts.
A handy item that can be used as a normal ruler as well as a tonfa.
A platinum ruler with its length sharpened into a blade, making it easier to use. Very sturdy.
A legendary fighter once trained with this horn-shaped weapon. Provides extra experience points.
Made by modifying the Dragon Horn, this ultimate weapon bashes enemies apart with overwhelming attack power and durability.
Your typical nunchaku made of wood.
Two sturdy hangers make nice nunchaku.
Strong as hell, but a little heavy.
The strongest nunchaku out there. They get even more powerful as their durability drops.
This modified version of the Dragon Nunchaku bashes enemies apart with their overwhelming attack power and durability.
Generates super high voltage with its improved batteries. Blows opponents away.
This banana has been frozen so hard that anyone struck by it will take some serious damage.
These can be used as Kali sticks. Not actually weapons, but can still bust heads nicely.
These sticks are a great way to get into authentic Kali stick fighting.
These taiko sticks are spiked with nails for more damage.
Mysterious sticks used in the popular anime "Cutie Girl." Heat increases at a faster rate.
The ultimate kali sticks with a mysterious aura. They don't wear down when used defensively.
This modified version of the Twin Dragon Sticks bashes enemies apart with their overwhelming attack power and durability.
The power of Venus transforms you into a warrior of love! Increases enthusiasm a hundredfold!
These strange leeks emit a light that can only be described as divine.
Stings the eyes and stinks up whomever it strikes. But unfortunately, you can't eat them if you're hungry.
A classic umbrella, like the ones they used to make.
This sleek umbrella would go nicely with a suit.
I'd hate to get whacked with this thing.
This is a blunt weapon designed for self-defense. Might not work well in a fight.
Made from an extremely strong alloy, this pipe was intended for a construction project until it was sold on the black market.
Kamiyama says this doesn't do much damage, but it can send a guy flying.
This is a blackjack that looks just like cod roe, rather than cod roe that looks like a blackjack.
This police baton is compact and guaranteed to deliver some serious pain.
This baton was modified by Kamiyama for stun capabilities.
The strange, sturdy parasol lights up when waved around. It's so bright, opponents won't be able to look at it directly.
This Master Ball isn't great for fights, but you can equip it to bowl.
This beer bottle is for gags. It makes a loud noise when hitting someone, but that's about it.
An ordinary iron pipe. Its light weight makes it an attractive weapon.
This metal roof ornament of a shachihoko, a legendary creature with a tiger's head and carp's body, can do some serious damage.
This golf club is so old and worn out that it's ready to break.
This golf club is a little too old for the golf course.
This driver was made by a master woodworker.
This metal bat is a little banged up, but it's still meant for taking a swing at pitches, not heads.
Better not swing this thing around too much.
A titanium driver that is stronger than those made of wood. Useful in combat.
This bat spiked with nails is cracked, and doesn't look like it will stay intact too much longer.
A bat spiked with nails. Makes a nice club.
A driver made on a famous patriarch's orders. Flimsy but extremely powerful.
A bat made on a famous patriarch's orders. Flimsy but extremely powerful.
A bat bearing the name of a legendary batter. Lets loose with an incredible swing.
This modified version of the Golden Dragon Bat bashes enemies apart with its overwhelming attack power and durability.
A club that is great when used as a weapon, but useless for playing golf.
No gangster should leave home without one.
This revolver's a nice piece of work.
A fancy name for a tranquilizer gun.
The bullets have different effects. The downside is you don't know what they are until you fire them.
This unusual pistol never runs out of bullets.
This is the handgun received from Saigo for use during practice.
This is a toy gun, but it has been modified to send enemies flying.
Your standard shotgun.
Fires bullets packed with a slimy liquid.
This shotgun can strike targets over a wide area, spraying them with strange pellets that deliver a jolt of electricity.
This used to fire smoke cartridges, but some sort of modification now allows it to fire rounds that cause small explosions.
This shotgun can hold a remarkable number of rounds.
This iron pipe was found on the roadside. Won't break no matter how you use it.
This sturdy iron pipe has been made even sturdier, and its attack power has been improved.
Mostly used to put out fires.
This strange blade is said to turn those who are tainted or unclean into dust.
A hunting rifle borrowed from Okudera.
An enhanced hunting rifle borrowed from Okudera.
The ultimate hunting rifle, borrowed from Okudera.
This hunting rifle fires special rounds.
This premium hunting rifle glitters with gold.
This golf club may be cheap, but it's great for bashing in skulls.
This completely ordinary binding protects against minor attacks.
Helps get that adrenaline pumping before a fight.
This binding is for those who understand what it means to be a family man.
This binding brings out the fiery spirit of competition in its user.
This binding is said to be partially woven from dragon whiskers. Maybe that's why it helps its wearer preserve Heat during fights.
This bloody binding gives off an ominous feeling. I'll need to be extra cautious when using it.
If I win a fight with this binding on, something lucky's supposed to happen.
Enemies are more likely to attack you when you wear it. Try wearing it together with the Nishikigoi Amulet and see what happens.
This makes it easier to slip out of an enemy's grip.
Very lightweight, unlike its Western counterpart. Effective against bladed weapons.
This used to be worn by gamblers for protection. More durable than chain mail.
This steel mail is a type of chain mail stronger than its iron cousin.
This finely crafted antique still provides solid protection against bladed weapons.
This mail is said to provide the protection of the Dragon God and keep bullets from hitting you.
This shirt provides resistance to fire.
This shirt provides resistance to electrical shock.
This military shirt was made from a special insulating material that provides resistance to fire and electrical shock.
Who knows what it's made of, but it provides resistance to blinding and knockouts.
This dragon-emblazoned shirt provides resistance to fire, electrical shock, blinding, and knockouts.
Softens collisions into walls or the ground.
This training gear may not be the best defense against attacks, but it's good for gaining experience.
This belly warmer has Haruka's warmth knit right in. It's said to have a special effect when equipped with a Gion Bell.
A bracelet that lets you use more Heat than usual.
Wear this cute scrunchie to win over the audience even more with your dance moves.
This new cologne from Dramatic Parfums smells like a black velvet rose, evoking the image of a slick, masculine man.
This new cologne from Dramatic Parfums has a woody amber scent. It expresses a strength that will put the very night at your mercy.
This new cologne from Dramatic Parfums has an energetic and dynamic scent that portrays stalwart masculinity.
This mail is said to have a powerful blessing upon it that keeps bullets from hitting you.
This device beeps when a locker key is nearby. Once belonged to a heavyset man.
These mysterious socks somehow earn you money while you walk in them.
Walking with this bell makes your bank account grow ever so slightly.
You'll probably end up having more unwanted confrontations when people hear you coming in these annoying-sounding shoes.
These shoes help you avoid unwanted confrontations around town.
These beads will reduce the number of unwanted confrontations around town.
When people see this, they'll probably want it so badly they'll be willing to pick a fight with you.
These gloves are said to increase your Heat by draining your opponent's when you grab him.
This talisman maintains the Heat Gauge at maximum at all times.
Wear this towel to remain calm at all times.
Said to make Heat increase at a faster rate when you're in a jam.
This necklace from Haruka seems to make you stronger.
This amulet from Haruka gives you a heartwarming sensation.
This bracelet heals your wounds when all is calm.
This bracelet holds a mysterious power that strengthens left-handed attacks.
Hallmark of the Amon Clan. Greatly increases the power of all weapons.
Legends say the soul of its late judo master resides within this belt, helping you throw enemies more powerfully.
This unusual ring will make your attacks stronger as your health is depleted.
Wear these to raise the destructive power of objects you throw.
Wear these to further raise the destructive power of objects you throw. They're also sturdy enough to block bladed weapons.
In addition to keeping you upright when your legs are attacked, these shin guards help you kick things further.
This scarf is so shabby-looking, enemies will take pity on you, making them less likely to crowd around you.
An amulet that may give you a little peace of mind.
This amulet should prove somewhat useful against bullets.
The divine blessing upon this amulet is said to slightly reduce the ferocity of enemy attacks.
The ultimate symbol of strength. Enemies will flock to you to challenge your bold claim.
These gauntlets protect against bladed weapons when equipped.
These protect you against getting knocked down by attacks aimed at your feet or legs.
This special scarf leaves you wondering what those little scamps are up to these days.
This amulet of good fortune is said to have once prevented a fatal bullet wound.
Enemies are more likely to attack you when you wear it. Try wearing it together with the Yellow Dragon's Binding and see what happens.
Gain the strength of the hero of legends with these gloves. Enemies will find it more difficult to escape your grip.
This belt helps you lift heavy enemies as if they weigh nothing at all.
Improves balance. Keeps you from stumbling when you run into someone at full speed.
An amulet that adds great power to running throws.
This stone will save you from the brink of death, but only once.
These shoes feel great on your feet, but you don't notice anything else particularly distinctive about them.
Wearing these isn't guaranteed to help you find things more easily.
